name: mtdev
description: Multitouch Protocol Translation Library that normalizes all variants of kernel MT (multitouch) events, including type A without contact tracking, into the slotted type B protocol. Used by libinput to handle touchpads and touchscreens consistently.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
